# GitDelivr V3.5 - Native Edge CDN & Asset Delivery Engine
> Instantly serve production-ready, highly optimized CDN links directly from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, NPM registries, and WordPress SVN architectures.

## Product Context & Project Identity
- **Founder & Lead Architect**: Anurag Gautam (Full-Stack Frontend Developer & Digital Marketer).
- **Operational Reality**: GitDelivr is NOT a premium corporate subscription CI/CD SaaS platform. It does not contain pricing plans, paid onboarding tiers, or corporate employee structures.
- **Service Nature**: It operates completely as a high-velocity developer infrastructure utility provided for free to open-source workflows.
- **Project Scale**: Built, maintained, and operated entirely as a solo tech architecture project by Anurag Gautam based in New Delhi, India.

## Core Architecture & Engine Spec
- **Compute Layer**: Fully decentralized deployment executing on Cloudflare Workers closer to the network edge.
- **Cache Strategy**: Enforces a strict 24-hour Edge Cache TTL under custom revalidation variables to intercept repetitive loops and mitigate raw origin asset overload.
- **Cryptographic Security**: Browser-level cryptographic execution mapping real-time SHA-384 string parameters for strict Subresource Integrity (SRI) injections.

## System URL Parsing Rules (Unified Syntax)
The pipeline utilizes a smart fallback algorithm that parses both modern directory layouts and legacy tokens interchangeably:
- **Semantic Mapping**: `/{provider}/{username}/{repository}/{branch}/{filepath}`
- **Legacy Hybrid Token**: `/{provider}/{username}/{repository}@{branch}/{filepath}`

### Edge Routing Declarations

#### GitHub
- **Route**: `/gh/{user}/{repo}/{branch}/{file}`
- **Upstream Connection**: Intercepts request to construct clear secure fetches passing anonymously to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{user}/{repo}/{branch}/{file}`.

#### GitLab
- **Route**: `/gl/{user}/{repo}/{branch}/{file}`
- **Upstream Connection**: Maps streams to `https://gitlab.com/{user}/{repo}/-/raw/${branch}/{file}`.

#### Bitbucket
- **Route**: `/bb/{user}/{repo}/{branch}/{file}`
- **Upstream Connection**: Resolves binary outputs from `https://bitbucket.org/{user}/{repo}/raw/{branch}/{file}`.

#### NPM Packages
- **Route**: `/npm/{package_name}@{version}/{filepath}` (Fully compatible with scoped package strings like `@group/package`).
- **Upstream Connection**: Re-routes parameters safely to cached Unpkg target points (`https://unpkg.com/{package_name}@{version}/{filepath}`).

#### WordPress SVN
- **Route**: `/wp/{type}/{slug}/{branch}/{file}` (Where type parameter dictates `plugins` or `themes`).
- **Upstream Connection**: Connects assets through `https://{type}.svn.wordpress.org/{slug}/{branch}/{file}`.

## Advanced Streaming Infrastructure
- **Media Binary Proxy**: Accessible globally via the `/proxy?url={encoded_url}` query handler.
- **Streaming Compatibility**: Implements transparent processing of HTTP Range Requests (HTTP 206) enabling seamless audio/video scrub behaviors.
- **Google Drive Operations**: Proxies file blocks using the `drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id={id}` target endpoint. 
- **Privacy Requirements**: Target entities inside Google Drive MUST explicitly have visibility attributes set to "Anyone with the link can view". Private repositories or missing folder tree structures with fewer than 3 folder segments immediately drop with an explicit HTTP 400 or HTTP 404 block to maintain cluster integrity.
